description: Boundary coverage for extracting the canonical owner/repository identifier from valid SSH-style Git remote addresses of the form user@host:owner/name. Exercises a minimal owner/name pair, repository names that themselves contain dots, a repository name that already ends in the version-control suffix before the canonical suffix, and identifiers built from mixed letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. The input is a single URL string and the output is the owner and repository name joined by a single forward slash.
